list: Official PS5 trophy list as published by PlayStation (names, descriptions and grades as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase, who agree on all 55). Guides are original paraphrases written for this entry; each cites its sources.

trophies.guide: What: earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum pops on its own. How: there is no separate task, no online play and no DLC needed — it is the reward for finishing everything else in this guide. When it can be missed: never; it unlocks the moment the 54th trophy lands, in story or free-roam.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.guide: What: finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1. How: play the story — the trophy is automatic and pops as the mission ends. When it can be missed: it cannot be missed; every story trophy unlocks by playing the chapters in order.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.guide: What: finish Chapter 1 of the story. How: play through the chapter, then start the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag? — the trophy pops at that handover. When it can be missed: never. Save tip: keep a manual save at the end of each chapter (15 manual slots, 1 autosave) because there is no mission replay.

sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase

trophies.guide: What: finish Chapter 2. How: play the chapter to its end, then begin the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City, and the trophy unlocks. When it can be missed: never — story trophies are automatic. Note: Chapter 2 is also when you unlock switching between Jason and Lucia (after Coffee Break) and the partner trophies become possible.

trophies.guide: What: finish Chapter 3. How: complete the chapter, then play the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life — the trophy pops after them. When it can be missed: never. By this point the Key Cloner, jewelry jobs and fence contacts are open, so robbery trophies start unlocking too.

trophies.guide: What: finish Chapter 4. How: play to the end of the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero — the trophy pops when that mission completes. When it can be missed: never. The same final mission also unlocks the gold final-mission trophy, so the two land together.

When it can be missed: never. After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% checklist opens under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.

trophies.guide: What: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. How: after the story the checklist opens under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — progress made during the story already counts. It is far kinder than true 100% (closer to 60%): you need any 100 optional missions out of 200-300+, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned with the WAiNK app, any 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, and any 70 of 80 challenges. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need full completion. When it can be missed: nothing toward 100% is missable — everything is doable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase

trophies.guide: What: complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida (300 are needed for the 100% checklist). How: four types count and mix freely — 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 under-the-bridges flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridges runs are the quickest to chain. Track progress per region under Progress, Activities, Stunts (press R3 on a category), or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and stays marked once done. When it can be missed: never; stunts stay available in free-roam.

sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: What: try each of the 9 activity types once. How: open Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see the nine and your count on each — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. Most arrive on their own through the story and map unfogging; filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the rest. When it can be missed: never; every activity type stays open in free-roam.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: What: earn gold in all 42 shooting-range challenges spread over 12 range locations. How: visit each range and clear every challenge at gold standard — the ranges also feed the 100% checklist, which needs all of them. Practise the weapon each challenge uses and replay until gold; ranges stay open after the story. When it can be missed: never.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: What: win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). How: find each location, race the drone course and finish first — every location needs at least one win. Drone races are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so this trophy lands on the way to A Long Road. When it can be missed: never; races stay open in free-roam.

trophies.guide: What: win 20 different races. How: there are 40 unique race locations — win any 20 of them, one win per location. Mix car races, race challenges and drone races; the map marks race spots once unfogged. When it can be missed: never; races stay open in free-roam.

trophies.guide: What: beat Cal in a fishing challenge. How: after the Chapter 1 mission where you meet Cal (Feng Shui), he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon — follow his fishing questline and out-fish him in the challenge. When it can be missed: never; Cal's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.guide: What: finish one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck. How: the first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 (interact with the controllers); the fourth sits at arcade machines around the world. Finishing all levels of any one game once is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge. When it can be missed: never; the games stay playable after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: What: finish Andy's optional questline (Lucia only). How: in Chapter 3, playing as Lucia, Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville, marking the line on the map. Complete her 5 quests in order — the Cellerichain climb, paying the Cellerica fee, the initiation, retrieving the van, and the warehouse meet — and the trophy pops at the last one. When it can be missed: never; all of Andy's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: What: finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. How: the line marks itself in Chapter 1; a while after the Island Dreams mission Kenton calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you to 7 shipwrecks — purple treasure-chest icons on the map — where you dive, use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. Turn in one set and he calls with more. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. When it can be missed: never; Kenton goes quiet for a stretch in Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (calling Brian as Jason speeds it up).

trophies.guide: What: finish Billy's optional questline. How: after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break the line marks itself at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests — checking out the mud club, two jobs with Billy, stealing the Impaler, and the hometown finale — and the trophy pops at the last. trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: What: complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. How: find stranger questlines in the open world — only certain ones count (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy). Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's skunk-ape hunt, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street-race mentoring and Pilot Pete's delivery runs; more strangers are still being mapped. Track your count in the trophy list itself. When it can be missed: never; strangers stay in the world after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: What: finish Randy's Wish List questline. How: it marks itself after the Chapter 3 mission where you steal the Zorrusso with the Key Cloner. Randy then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); the game marks some cars in fixed spots and flags others as you scan or enter them with the WAiNK app. Deliver each in good condition for better pay — street cars count too. When it can be missed: never; the list stays open after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: What: finish Tyrone's questline (Jason only). How: after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for synthetic labs in Vice City — go and destroy them in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest. Destroy enough labs and Tyrone hands you the Spin On This quest to shut the labs down; finishing it pops the trophy. When it can be missed: never; the labs stay available after the story.

sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: What: meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations — the ONLY trophy that can be missed. How: meditate at each spot; doing a spot with both Jason and Lucia together counts double (+2). Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is only available during Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, in the morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. It raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — do it anyway. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). When it can be missed: the Chapter 1 house meditation is gone forever after Chapter 1 — keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until you have done it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: What: hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel (Jason only). How: after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Do it and he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest — one clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track the 15 Target Decks under Map, Activities, Target Deck (all 15 are needed for 100% anyway). When it can be missed: never; Bret's line stays open after the story. Note: which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.guide: What: complete 3 collectible card sets. How: find cards across Leonida and finish any 3 full sets — there are 18 card-set locations in total, so pick the sets whose cards you find first. Cards are a pure collectible hunt with no combat gate. When it can be missed: never; cards stay in the world after the story.

trophies.guide: What: scan 100 WAiNK locations. How: hold Up on the D-pad and R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures you walk past — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures exist, far more than the 100 needed, so any 100 count. Scan as you travel and it finishes on its own. When it can be missed: never; scan points stay in the world.

trophies.guide: What: complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. How: open Progress, Challenges to browse them — most complete naturally while working on other trophies and the 100% checklist. Since 100% needs any 70 of 80, this trophy pops on the way; leave it until late, then pick the easiest remaining ones. When it can be missed: never; challenges stay open in free-roam.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: What: with your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat zone. How: earliest after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner with Right on the D-pad plus Triangle. Cause chaos until 4 stars, then escape: a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape route because police and helicopters struggle to follow there. The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone. It also tends to pop on its own during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission line, which always triggers 4-star heat. When it can be missed: never.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: What: with your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time. How: after Coffee Break, call your partner (Right on the D-pad plus Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) without ever dropping the flashing wanted level — keep the red-blue flashing level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3: loot a few items in each, crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and keep going to a 4th shop if the 3rd does not pop it — the unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop. When it can be missed: never.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase

trophies.guide: What: discover 100 vehicles. How: use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly) and scan vehicles as they pass — just stand on a busy road and scan everything; you only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it. The game has 557 vehicles at launch and 100% needs 200 base models scanned, so this pops on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. When it can be missed: never.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: What: drop 5 enemies during one Combat Focus. How: activate Combat Focus with L3 plus R3 while aiming — time slows and weak points light up, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or a wash, and use Adrenaline to stretch the window. Line up 5 enemies (gang-operation criminals work; soldiers, police and civilians do not seem to count), wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Focus has 4 levels — raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — and at level 4 this gets much easier. When it can be missed: never.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: What: steal a large passenger plane docked at a VCIA departure terminal and fly away. How: go to Vice City International Airport, enter a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — the easiest is at terminals E3/E4, reached through a fence gap or the stairs by the bridge, not the planes parked on the open airfield. Board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport; the unlock is slightly delayed. When it can be missed: never.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.guide: What: steal a military tank (a Rhino) and use it. How: go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and fire at enemies until the trophy pops. When it can be missed: never; the base and its tanks stay there in free-roam.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: What: rob a jewelry store silently. How: first finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry-store robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick it — that trips the alarm), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave. The trophy pops shortly after you walk out. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target. When it can be missed: never.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.guide: What: rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time. How: finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it teaches the method and counts as the first vault. After that, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000, after his earlier Payday Loans jobs): follow a marked van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. Each vault triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and swap cars to lose the heat. All 8 vaults are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way — and a single vault can pay up to $205,000. When it can be missed: never.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: What: rob an armored truck and escape. How: the easiest way is the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — tailing the security van to a bank vault counts as robbing the truck, so it pops there. Earlier method: spot armored trucks driving near banks in Vice City, block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs). When it can be missed: never.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.guide: What: fully unfog the map — explore all 52 areas of Leonida. How: fly a plane over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible; a plane covers ground far faster than driving. Exploring also marks activities, races and collectibles as you go, so do it early and let the rest of the guide fill in. When it can be missed: never; the fog only lifts, it never returns.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: What: rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. How: there are 39 gang operations in total, marked by yellow icons when you get near them (many also mark themselves through story progress). One per gang is enough for the trophy, but 100% needs all 39, so it pops on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs. When it can be missed: never; operations stay on the map in free-roam.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: What: steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. How: the site is a gang operation that marks itself during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation (you need them for the safe). Inside, grab the 3 golden-icon valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it open). The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while — go back and take what is left. When it can be missed: never; the valuables can be collected across visits.

trophies.guide: What: have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. How: after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break you can switch between the two characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness-club membership and train, always bringing your partner along (Right on the D-pad plus Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other finishes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, select a character, scroll to Strength. Fitness clubs are filterable on the map under Activities. When it can be missed: never.

trophies.guide: What: perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. How: play normally — every robbery, stealthy objective, clean escape, shootout and act of chaos counts toward the 500, and the trophy list itself shows your running count. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) to see a small demon face appear whenever an action registers. Profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable — Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid living at the extreme end. Most players hit 500 passively while finishing everything else; if you are short at the end, any profile-affecting action still counts. When it can be missed: never.

trophies.guide: What: complete the UFO easter egg. How: go alone at night (after 2 AM) to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it: it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside. The trophy pops then. The spawn is slightly random, so expect a few tries. When it can be missed: never; the easter egg stays available in free-roam.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: What: launder $250,000 of marked bills through your fence contacts. How: first finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, carry the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most) and hand them over. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not one delivery. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single job, so this fills fast once vaults open in Chapter 4. When it can be missed: never; fences and robberies stay open in free-roam.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: What: register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. How: the app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers at first, and registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes. When it can be missed: never.
